|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[You May Start Your Landing (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-3-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[You May Start Your Landing (V)]] (original, release sheet of 14 September 2012); [[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 12 December 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[You May Start Your Landing (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012; the slip [[:File:VB8-p2-56-You_May_Start_Your_Landing.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB8-D-youmaystartyourlanding-pre.gif]] print it, with the [Virtual Block 2] icon before “Imperial Control”)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 2, slip 3 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 33) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 (this page); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33, page 33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (Virtual Block 8 lists, shown there by 12 December 2012, the first archived capture after the 8.2 release, and still on 11 January 2013) prints “an AT-At” and “Walker Garrrison” (typos kept as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1282_3">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text in the VBlock8Name and VBlock8Rarity lists of 13 December 2012</ref>: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-At (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 33)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[You May Start Your Landing (V)]]) again, word for word: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-3-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-youmaystartyourlanding-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[You May Start Your Landing (V)]]) again, word for word: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
